# Global Paws

> A family-run IPATA-certified pet travel and relocation specialist in Hong Kong offering comprehensive international and domestic pet transport solutions with IATA compliance.

Global Paws provides end-to-end pet relocation services for individuals and corporations, handling documentation, veterinary procedures, airline coordination, and door-to-door delivery. The company serves multiple destinations including New Zealand, UK, Japan, France, Singapore, and the United States.

## Key Topics

- Pet Relocation
- International Pet Transport
- IATA Compliance
- IPATA Certification

- Door-to-Door Service
- Domestic Pet Travel
